violations.text: The ware washing area/back prep area does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026
The mop sink faucet was observed in poor repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/10/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in cooler shelves, and fan cover have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

The floor under the dry storage area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

The ceiling in the back prep and ware-washing area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Per owner, ceiling tiles will be replaced, and back room is getting a renovation. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with food debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Employee cleaned and sanitized during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2025

The ceiling in the back prep and ware-washing area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Establishment is currently undergoing renovation per manager. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2024

Observed several damped mops not being air dried. Proper drying of mops was reviewed. Mops must be allowed to air dry after use. Mops were relocated to designated spot to air dry. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2025

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed throughout the establishment. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Per interview of manager the unused equipment will be donated/or removed. Establishment is currently undergoing renovations. New Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2025

Observed dim lighting in walk-in cooler. Proper lighting intensity was reviewed. At least 108 lux (10-foot candles) at a distance of 75 cm (30 inches) above the floor, in walk-in refrigeration units and dry FOOD storage areas and in other areas and rooms during periods of cleaning. New Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2025
The ceiling in the back prep and ware-washing area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2024
